cards.example: 蒙古族有着与汉族不同的统治观念。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Mongols had different concepts of rule from the Han people.
cards.breakdown: 观：雚（一种鸟）加眼睛（见），仔细观察，形成想法 · 念：今（今天）加心（心），心里记挂着今天的事，引申为想法

cards.back: skilled in battle / good at fighting
cards.example: 蒙古骑兵骁勇善战，所向披靡。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mongol cavalry were brave and skilled in battle, sweeping all before them.
cards.breakdown: 善：像羊（羊）一样温良，把事情做得很好，引申为擅长 · 战：拿着武器（戈）与人争斗（占）

cards.example: 忽必烈清楚地知道必须保护农业。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan clearly understood that agriculture had to be protected.
cards.breakdown: 清：水（氵）清澈透明，看得一清二楚 · 楚：丛林（林）里的荆棘，刺得清清楚楚，毫不含糊

cards.back: to entrust with important tasks / to give a key position to
cards.example: 忽必烈重用汉族官员，帮助治理国家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan gave key positions to Han officials to help govern the country.
cards.breakdown: 重：人挑着沉甸甸（千）的东西，引申为重要、看重 · 用：用桶来盛水，代表使用和任用

cards.example: 忽必烈大力发展农业，恢复社会经济。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan vigorously developed agriculture and restored the social economy.
cards.breakdown: 大：人张开双臂，表示广大有力 · 力：手臂弯曲用力，代表力量和努力

cards.example: 义军领袖朱元璋带兵打败元军，推翻了元朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang led troops to defeat the Yuan army and overthrow the Yuan Dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 领：发号施令（令）的那个头（页），带领大家 · 袖：衣袖（衤）里藏着（由）东西，引申为身居核心的人物

cards.example: 元朝在国内各地设立行省，进行管理。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty established provinces throughout the country for governance.
cards.breakdown: 内：走进门（冂）里面，就是内部了

cards.example: 西藏成为元朝的正式行政区。
cards.exampleTranslation: Tibet became an official administrative region of the Yuan.
cards.breakdown: 区：把东西分隔（匚）收入格子里，区分开来，表示一个划定的范围

cards.back: to investigate thoroughly / to check and verify
cards.example: 元朝官员清查户口，登记人口和土地。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yuan officials thoroughly checked household registers and recorded the population and land.
cards.breakdown: 清：水（氵）清澈，把事情看得清楚 · 查：像在树（木）上用棍子（且）探查，仔细检查

cards.back: to establish / to set up (an office or institution)
cards.example: 元朝设立澎湖巡检司，管理台湾地区。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan established the Penghu Patrol Inspection Office to govern the Taiwan region.
cards.breakdown: 设：用言语（讠）规划，然后动手（殳）建造 · 立：一个人叉开双腿，稳稳站在地上

cards.example: 元朝管理澎湖列岛和附近海域。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan governed the Penghu Island chain and nearby waters.
cards.breakdown: 列：用刀（刂）把东西切分，一排排整齐列好 · 岛：像鸟（鸟）站在山（山）上，四面环水的陆地

cards.example: 忽必烈在各地建立孔庙，推广儒学教育。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan built Confucius Temples throughout the land to promote Confucian education.
cards.breakdown: 孔：小孩（子）穿过一个洞口，原意为小孔，孔子是儒家始祖 · 庙：朝堂（朝）里庄严神圣的建筑（广）

cards.example: 元朝重视儒学教育，在各地兴办学校。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty valued Confucian education and established schools throughout the land.
cards.breakdown: 教：大人（父）手拿棍子教导孩子（子） · 育：母亲（母省）生下孩子（子），哺育其成长

cards.example: 马可·波罗是著名的意大利旅行家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Marco Polo was a famous Italian traveler.
cards.breakdown: 著：植物（艹）生长得很茂盛（者），引申为显著突出 · 名：傍晚（夕）看不见时互相呼喊名字（口），让人记住

cards.example: 元曲是中国现代戏曲艺术的重要开端。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yuan opera was an important beginning for modern Chinese drama arts.
cards.breakdown: 开：用手把门打开，引申为开始 · 端：站得笔直（立），手（专）指着正前方，表示起点和正式开始

cards.example: 元朝中期，海外贸易空前发达。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the mid-Yuan period, overseas trade was unprecedentedly thriving.
cards.breakdown: 贸：把财物（贝）拿出去与人交换（卯），做买卖 · 易：把东西交换出去，代表交换和互通有无

cards.example: 欧亚之间的商业活动在元朝十分活跃。
cards.exampleTranslation: Commercial activities between Europe and Asia were very active during the Yuan.
cards.breakdown: 欧：越过山区（区字旁），来到欧洲大陆 · 亚：比最高差一点，也指亚洲

cards.example: 元朝的商业十分繁荣，市场热闹非凡。
cards.exampleTranslation: Commerce in the Yuan Dynasty was very prosperous, with lively markets.
cards.breakdown: 商：来来往往讨价还价（商量），做生意的人 · 业：像书架一排排竖立，表示一项事业

cards.back: to cause a sensation / to create a stir
cards.example: 马可·波罗的游记轰动了整个欧洲。
cards.exampleTranslation: Marco Polo's travel memoir caused a sensation throughout Europe.
cards.breakdown: 轰：很多车（车）同时轰鸣，声音震天 · 动：用力（力）搬动沉重（重）的东西，引发震动

cards.example: 棉花的种植在南方普遍起来。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cotton cultivation became widespread in the south.
cards.breakdown: 普：太阳（日）照耀着所有人（并），无处不在，人人都有 · 遍：走遍（辶）每一个地方（扁），到处都是

cards.example: 黄道婆推广了棉花的种植和纺织技术。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Daopo promoted the cultivation of cotton and textile technology.
cards.breakdown: 棉：树木（木）上长出像白雪一样柔软的棉球（帛旁） · 花：植物（艹）开出美丽花朵（化），棉花形如白花

cards.back: to improve / to make improvements to
cards.example: 黄道婆改进了纺车技术，使棉布大量生产。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Daopo improved spinning wheel technology, enabling mass production of cotton cloth.
cards.breakdown: 改：用棍子（攵）纠正自己（己）的错误，让事物变得更好 · 进：走进（辶）更好的地方（隹），向前进步

cards.example: 元朝的科学技术取得了很多重要成就。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty achieved many important accomplishments in science and technology.
cards.breakdown: 技：用手（扌）掌握一门专业技能（支） · 术：树（木）里面有一个核心，那是技术的精髓所在

cards.back: to preserve / to keep / to hold on to
cards.example: 元朝末期，统治者无法保住自己的政权。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Yuan period, rulers could not hold on to their regime.
cards.breakdown: 保：人（亻）把孩子（子）护在怀里，紧紧保护 · 住：人（亻）站定（主）在一个地方，稳稳守住不放

cards.example: 元朝末期，社会矛盾越来越深，民心大乱。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Yuan, social contradictions deepened and the people's hearts were in turmoil.
cards.breakdown: 矛：古代长柄武器，用来刺击进攻 · 盾：古代防御盾牌，用来抵挡——矛与盾相互对立，比喻矛盾冲突

cards.example: 元朝末期，水灾、旱灾等灾害频繁发生。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Yuan, disasters such as floods and droughts occurred frequently.
cards.breakdown: 灾：洪水（川）与大火（火）交替肆虐，带来大灾难 · 害：屋（宀）里有人（口）遭到刀（丰）伤害，危险降临

cards.back: final period / last phase / end stage
cards.example: 元朝末期，各地义军纷纷起义，推翻了元朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the final period of the Yuan Dynasty, rebel armies rose up everywhere and overthrew it.
cards.breakdown: 末：树木（木）顶端加一横，表示最顶端、最末端 · 期：按规律（其）按月（月）推算，到了最后一段时间
